method.cold: Four independent new Chrome contexts, separate A/B and player/GM first use; HTTP cache disabled; first Canvas call uses newly loaded sample bytes/modules. PNG after first preview still starts a fresh decode set.
method.warm: Repeated independent render/export calls reuse same loaded JS modules and Blob bytes, alternating GM/player. No persistent ImageBitmap cache exists or is claimed.
method.pixels: SHA-256 over full real Canvas/decoded PNG sRGB RGBA; all alpha bytes counted; no projection-only pixel substitute.
method.matrix: 2 variants x 2 audiences x 2 outputs (1024 preview/4096 PNG) x 2 states (new context/repeated modules and bytes) = 16 observations per case
